summary: Master model risk management with validation, governance, and monitoring tools. Build practical skills for stronger oversight and audit readiness.
lede: Managing model risk means assessing how models can produce unreliable outputs and setting controls across their lifecycle. For professionals responsible for models, control frameworks or governance reporting, the course builds practical skills in inventorying and tiering models, reviewing conceptual soundness and testing performance. Learners also practice monitoring drift, documenting validation findings and remediation, and preparing governance reports that connect findings to risk appetite.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with models, control frameworks, or governance reporting and need stronger practical methods for oversight, validation, and monitoring.
prerequisites: You should bring prior exposure to risk, credit, analytics, compliance, or model governance work. A laptop and spreadsheet software are required for exercises; no coding, statistical programming, or advanced machine learning setup is needed. Familiarity with model documentation, validation results, or governance reporting will make the course more immediately applicable.
